dimensions.placementUncertainty: Both supplied STEP files retain their native relative coordinates and common rigidZtranslation-3.2mm. No supplied panel/enclosureCAD establishes alignment, so fit/fastener/contact are unverified.

inspectionGroups.notes: Debug separation shows retained native controller/adapter. Not a validated assembly alignment.
Approximate exterior only, no snapfit or disassembly claim.

limitations: No hardware-fit or browser/WebGL acceptance is implied by the retained CAD or CPU geometry checks.
Factory display execution is independently recorded in product limitations; a model screen only shows the actual emulator framebuffer.

Native CAD contains1031 controller components and21 adapter components; both assemblies retained with native coordinates. Source files do not establish enclosure mounting; alignment and internal clearances remain estimates.
Enclosure variants use distinct192.6×123.5×11.7,205×140.5×12 or250.2×169×12mm dimensions. Roundedcorners, camera/port/speakeropenings, fasteners and packageextras are not yet reconstructed.
Pixelplane preserves720:1280 or800:1280 aspect inside source aperture; no anisotropic source/model scaling or framebufferstretch. Portrait view is a rigid orientation choice.
No GPIO button hotspot is invented from uncalibrated internalCAD. Genuine touch/BOOT controls are available; no DSI framebuffer support is claimed.
